texts.biography: A courageous leader who rose against foreign domination and rallied the people to her cause. Her determination became a lasting symbol of resistance and independence in Dai Viet.
texts.name: Trung Trac

specialty.name: War Elephants
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of any War Elephants or Royal Elephants by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every level (rounded up).
